Frequently Asked Questions

What is FixorAssist's towing service?+

It's part of our 24×7 roadside assistance offering — when a vehicle can't be fixed on the spot, we arrange safe towing to an authorised workshop or your preferred location, anywhere in our pan-India network.

How does it work?+

Call our helpline or raise a request in the app. We assess the situation, dispatch a verified tow partner, and you can track them in real time until your vehicle reaches its destination.

Is towing free?+

Yes, up to 25 km from the breakdown location. Beyond that, distance charges apply at prevailing rates — always confirmed with you first.

Is the service available nationwide?+

Yes — our network currently spans 250+ cities and is expanding. If your city isn't listed yet, call us and we'll still try to reach you.

Can I choose the towing destination?+

Yes, within your plan's coverage. If your preferred workshop is outside our network or beyond the free distance, standard charges apply.

What vehicles are covered?+

Cars and two-wheelers are covered under standard plans; commercial vehicles may have separate terms — check your plan document.
